entries.prompt: One continuous unbroken macro shot with no cuts, locked camera, single object centred. A rose of molten glossy black glass with a hot magenta inner glow softens, its petals loosen into slow liquid ribbons that lift and drift upward, the ribbons fuse into a translucent bell that pulses once and trails long glowing tendrils, becoming a black glass jellyfish floating against the deep crimson backdrop. Real fluid physics, surface tension, wet reflections, the object never leaves frame, it looks grown rather than built, like living alien technology. No text, no people.
